fields.acceptance: Tests with a hermetic HOME show that session run, before it starts the agent, leaves both paths with hasTrustDialogAccepted=true and every other key in .claude.json unchanged; that it honours CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and creates the file when it is missing; that a resumed start trusts the paths again; that --dry-run writes nothing; and that Adapter.Command still writes no file
fields.statement: Before every Claude Code start, the claudecode adapter marks the main checkout root and the session's working directory as trusted (hasTrustDialogAccepted=true) in ~/.claude.json, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json when set, through an optional adapter interface that session run calls, so a session in a new repo never stops at the folder-trust prompt

fields.acceptance: A test with a malformed .claude.json shows that session run starts the agent, reports a warning naming the file, and leaves the file byte-for-byte unchanged; the write goes through a temp file and a rename
fields.statement: When .claude.json can't be read, parsed or written, the session still starts, the failure appears in session run's warnings, and the file is never overwritten or left half-written
